about_the_game:
April 20th of 1945. In the middle of the chaos of the last days of World War II, the SSO (Strategic Services Office) launches a desperate mission. Their best agent, lieutenant Kawalski, a veteran of the Polish resistance tormented and haunted by his past, is sent in a suicide mission: prevent the resurgence of a dark empire before it's too late.

Accompanied by the Dogs of War squad, Kawalski will try to settle the score with those who took everything from him.

YOUR MISSION

You'll have to locate and eliminate the main leaders of a fallen empire before they escape from justice in 9 missions full of action, with environments that are completely interactive and destructible, recreated with real references from the era.

You will also have to seize the weapons and advanced technology developed by the regime and recover the priceless relics and art pieces plundered from the occupied territories, using both real weapons and advanced prototypes. Capture enemy vehicles and take strategic positions to make sure you emerge victorious!

YOUR COMRADES

You will not be alone. The Dogs of War squad is ready to support you:

  • Captain Hamilton and his bomber Lady Hell, to destroy enemy positions or send supplies.

  • Irina Pavlichenko, the lethal Ukranian sniper.

  • Jean-Claude Kunda, expert in sabotage and telecommunications.

  • Coronel Barnsby, the tactician that will lead the operation from headquarters.

YOUR FATE - AND THE WHOLE WORLD'S

Through the devastated ruins of Berlin, there will be an epic pursuit that will culminate in a showdown between the forces of good and evil. The result of this war waged in the shadows will seal the world's fate.

¡Comience the Mission!

FEATURES

  • Fusion of Genres: An explosive combination of run & gun, platforming and video adventure with tactical and challenging missions, and with a good dose of cheeky humour!

  • Cutscenes: Experience an intenese story about spies, commandos and mystery in World War II, narrated through incredible motion-comic scenes drawn and animated by hand.

  • More than 50 Characters and Vehicles: Fight 8 epic final bosses and interact with more than 50 unique characters between enemies, NPCs and vehicles while you advance on your mission.

  • Historical Weapons and Vehicles: Use real weapons and advanced prototypes, caspture enemy vehicles and take strategic positions to secure victory.

  • Exploration and Collectibles: Discover easter eggs, collect relics and art pieces to exhibit in the integrated museum, and unlock classified information with the TOP SECRET files.

  • Reward System: Win medals and badges completing challenges and prove your worth in the battlefield.

  • Carefully crafted Art: Enjoy a visual design that combines pixel art, 2D illustrations, 3D graphics and animations done frame by frame, designed traditionally. And as huge news, the main art for the game's cover was designed by the one and only Alfonso Azpiri!

  • Epic Soundtrack: Lose yourself in the music of Chris Huelsbeck, creator of iconic soundtracks like Turrican.

  • Unique Missions with high Replay Value: Enjoy 9 different missions, with very varied settings, enemies and ways of beating them. They will take on a tour through Berlin until you find the enemy's lair.

Add it now to your wishlist!
